museum.network.openMuseum.about.title: A public catalogue
museum.network.openMuseum.about.descript: The Museum publishes its accessions, scholarship, provenance, rights, and revision history in a public repository. Cryptographic commitments fix each published release, allowing readers to inspect the evidence behind a page and follow later corrections.
museum.network.openMuseum.about.invitati: Anyone may propose new evidence, clearer interpretation, better accessibility, or stronger preservation documentation through a reviewed pull request.
museum.network.openMuseum.about.boundary: Donor privacy, legal files, and custody-security material remain in the restricted registrar record.
museum.network.openMuseum.about.status: Working public statement · policy adoption pending
museum.network.openMuseum.transition.tit: A permanent record beyond the website
museum.network.openMuseum.transition.goa: The public repository is the bridge to an on-chain Museum record. The Fall 2026 goal is to give every admitted policy, decision, accession, provenance statement, rights record, preservation event, and correction a verifiable commitment and append-only lineage.
museum.network.openMuseum.transition.aut: The contract will preserve the identity, authority, effective date, content hash, and history of each admitted record. Essays, images, software, and conservation files can remain on content-addressed storage.
museum.network.openMuseum.transition.dis: The website remains the place to encounter the art and its scholarship. Its exhibitions and design may change while the institutional record remains continuous.
museum.network.openMuseum.transition.sta: Contract design in progress · deployment pending
Reference documents for the proposed registry, migration, and rights model. Contract deployment remains pending.
museum.network.mission.title: A permanent collection, held in public
museum.network.mission.description: The Museum collects internet-native art for long-term stewardship, research, interpretation, and access. Accessioned works are held for the benefit of the 6529 Network and the public commons.
museum.network.mission.permanence.title: Permanence
museum.network.mission.permanence.descri: Accession is a commitment to preserve the work, its provenance, and the conditions needed to encounter it.
museum.network.mission.knowledge.title: Public knowledge
museum.network.mission.knowledge.descrip: Interpretation, rights, technical evidence, and revision history belong with the artwork and remain open to study.
museum.network.mission.stewardship.title: Shared stewardship
museum.network.mission.stewardship.descr: Major decisions are accountable to TDH governance. No network member has a private claim on the collection or its returns.
museum.network.mission.rights.title: Open culture
museum.network.mission.rights.descriptio: CC0 is the default rights framework unless a future program expressly adopts another course.
